===================================================================
VanceSpectral Professional Plugin Suite - Windows Installation Guide
===================================================================

Version: 1.0.0
Publisher: Vance Audio
Supported Architectures: 64-bit (x64)
Supported OS: Windows 10, Windows 11

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
--------------------------
1. Run 'VanceSpectral_Setup_v1.0.0.exe' (or run Inno Setup on VanceSpectral_Windows_Installer.iss).
2. Select your desired plugin formats during setup:
   [X] VST3 Plugin (Installs to C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\VanceSpectral.vst3)
   [X] AAX Plugin  (Installs to C:\Program Files\Common Files\Avid\Audio\Plug-Ins\VanceSpectral.aaxplugin)
   [X] Standalone  (Installs to C:\Program Files\VanceSpectral\VanceSpectral.exe)
3. Open your DAW (FL Studio, Ableton Live, Reaper, Cubase, Studio One, Bitwig, Pro Tools) and run a plugin rescan.

UNINSTALLATION:
---------------
To uninstall, go to Windows Settings -> Apps -> Installed Apps -> VanceSpectral, and click Uninstall.
